name: The Dún Chaoin Crew

intro.text: We rowed to the Blaskets in worse than this, before your grandmother had a bicycle. The race is ours.
Settle it on the strand, then. We will bring the creatures. You bring the nerve.

win: Fair play. Fair play, and I will be blaming the tide until Christmas.
after: The Blaskets are a day's rowing and a lifetime's story. Mind the swell, and mind the tea.
